readout_fixed_before_running: Primary: paired comparison of the merged variant against the separate variant on the identical test pictures, per class and macro, for each architecture.

If the merged Bubble class reads worse than the four separate classes did, name the class responsible from the confusion cells: which class the merged Bubble pictures are predicted as, and which class's pictures are being predicted as Bubble.
Secondary: overall accuracy and macro F1 per run, with the single-run noise band quoted beside any delta.
The merged and separate numbers are always reported side by side, never one alone.
